notes: PT-RZ34K is a lens-less, large-venue 3-chip DLP laser projector (32,000 lm center, WUXGA), part of the PT-RQ35K/PT-RZ34K series (RZ34K = WUXGA variant of the 4K RQ35K). Desktop/ceiling-rigged unit, no rackUnits (not rack-mountable). Sold in US as PT-RZ34KU; specs are identical across regional SKUs aside from cosmetic/regulatory labeling. Data cross-verified across Panasonic EU spec PDF (rz34k_spec_en.pdf), Panasonic Connect Asia (Singapore) product page, ProjectorCentral spec page, and the official Operating Instructions manual (rear-panel terminal diagram, pages 32-34). Two MULTI PROJECTOR SYNC BNC terminals only apply to the 4K RQ35K per some sheets; on the RZ34K they double as MULTI SYNC/3D SYNC per the manual - included both terminals as dual-purpose per the manual's own labeling. REMOTE 2 IN is a D-sub 9-pin parallel control terminal, not true RS-232C serial - mapped to rs232 as the closest available connector id since no plain "9-pin D-sub" id exists in the allowed list. AC IN power inlet is confirmed as an IEC C13/C14-style panel inlet with a detachable supplied power cord (manual explicitly says "connect the supplied power cord" to the <AC IN> terminal), but the exact current-rated sub-type (standard C13/C14 vs. higher-current C19/C20) is not stated in any publicly available source, hence medium confidence overall. LAN and DIGITAL LINK RJ45 ports are both listed as 100Base-TX max in spec sheets (no gigabit Ethernet on this model), hence grade eth-100m rather than eth-1g.

ports.name: DVI-D IN
ports.note: DVI-D 24-pin, single-link only, DVI 1.0 compliant, HDCP compatible

ports.name: MULTI PROJECTOR SYNC IN/3D SYNC 1 IN/OUT
ports.note: Dual-purpose sync terminal, TTL high impedance

ports.name: MULTI PROJECTOR SYNC OUT/3D SYNC 2 OUT
ports.note: Dual-purpose sync terminal, TTL output max 10 mA

ports.name: DIGITAL LINK/LAN
ports.note: HDBaseT-compliant video/control input over Cat cable, 100Base-TX, PJLink Class 2, Art-Net, HDCP 2.2, Deep Color

ports.name: SERIAL IN
ports.note: D-sub 9-pin female, RS-232C compliant, for computer control

ports.name: REMOTE 1 IN
ports.note: M3 stereo mini-jack, wired remote input for multi-projector serial control

ports.name: REMOTE 1 OUT
ports.note: M3 stereo mini-jack, link control output

ports.name: REMOTE 2 IN
ports.note: D-sub 9-pin female, parallel external control circuit (closest listed match; is a D-sub 9-pin control port, not RS-232C protocol)

ports.name: USB
ports.note: For optional wireless module (AJ-WM50 series), USB memory (firmware/cloning)

ports.name: DC OUT 1
ports.note: USB Type A, power-only output, DC 5V

ports.name: DC OUT 2
ports.note: USB Type A, power-only output, DC 5V (total 2A shared across DC OUT 1+2)

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: AC 200-240V mains inlet; max power consumption 2450W (~12A at 200V). Exact IEC 60320 sub-type (C14 vs C19/C20) could not be confirmed from public spec sheets/manuals; C13/C14 rating (15A/250V) is electrically sufficient and used as closest listed match.
